snippet.title: Dixotomia - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Early Access Release Date Trailer for Dixotomia, a VR sci-fi vampire shooter developed by DeepMatrix. Players will embody a specialized SpecOps contractor to take up arms and fight against an evil vampire cult. Face off against bosses with the use of powerful weapons and vampire-based techniques to reveal the knowledge of a distant planet. Dixotomia is releasing into Early Access on August 21 for Meta Quest on the Meta Horizon Store.
